tools.name: ask_human_developer
tools.description: Connect the user with a real, manually approved human developer. Use it when the user asks for a human, a code review, a consultation or hands-on help, or when you have made a real attempt at their software problem and it is still not solved or is beyond what you can do reliably (unclear requirement

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "ask_human_developer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ask_human_developer" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
